name: ClinicalTrialSupplyDepotManager
tagline: IMP kit stock, FEFO resupply, shipments and excursion quarantine for every depot and site – in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete clinical trial supply app for Power Apps and Power Pages: dashboard of usable stock and resupply alerts, blinded inventory per depot and site, buffer-triggered resupply planner with FEFO depot selection and minimum shelf-life checks, shipment lanes with logger and ETA tracking, temperature excursion quarantine with four-eyes QA release, expiry and do-not-dispense rules.
features: Buffer / max resupply trigger with FEFO depot source
Four-eyes QA release with stability reference
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
